title: Merida China SILEX 7000 positioning recheck
notes: Exact SILEX 7000 page calls it a gravel adventure machine (砾石冒险机器), names long-distance bicycle travellers and long trips as uses, says the frame and carbon fork have extra mounts for more gear, lists F-MOUNT fender mounts, and allows 700x45 mm tires or 42 mm with fenders. The page does not position it for racing.
